rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: The Missing Truth
card.instruction: Treat every present exchange as incomplete until an old concealment, unanswered question, or broken confidence is finally addressed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we book our anniversary trip, why did you leave Venice early?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll stay the whole week this time. Nonrefundable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You paid for the last night then, too. What happened?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum was ill. She asked me not to tell anyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You could have said that afterwards. When you said you needed space from me, was that her request too?

card.title: The Missing Truth
card.instruction: Treat every present exchange as incomplete until an old concealment, unanswered question, or broken confidence is finally addressed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll renew my club membership once you explain why my curtain vote vanished.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're voting on curtains again. You can choose first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Where will you put my choice this time? Last year's blue never reached the minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll make you minute secretary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my first entry is 'Previous vote still unaccounted for.' Who can answer that?

card.title: The Secrecy Protocol
card.instruction: Treat concealment as a precise ritual with passwords, signals, approved phrases, and severe consequences for careless improvisation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write the password before I hand over the surprise picnic sandwiches.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're alone in the kitchen, and the bus leaves in two minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then write quickly. Speaking it cancels collection.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've written cucumber. That's yesterday's password, isn't it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've said it. The sandwiches stay here. I'll tell the walkers their lunch failed clearance.

card.title: The Secrecy Protocol
card.instruction: Treat concealment as a precise ritual with passwords, signals, approved phrases, and severe consequences for careless improvisation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Signal Mum's birthday cake location: three fingers for cupboard, four for fridge. Say it aloud and you're off the surprise team.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's on the table. The helpers need to find it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're off. Table is a flat palm. I'll signal them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already sent them a photo. That doesn't say anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It shows everything. Now we move the cake and change the signals. You won't be told where your slice is.

transfer.action: I place the unanswered old question beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: Everything new still runs into this blank. {request}
transfer.response: We can't call it settled while that line stays empty. {counter}
transfer.closing: I'd like to. The old question keeps introducing itself first.

transfer.action: I tap three times before indicating {prop}.
transfer.opening: Password first. Then the ordinary conversation. {request}
transfer.response: Use the approved gesture rather than the name. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then keeping the lunch password should be wonderfully manageable.
